clue.text: Underworld character seen in painting

temper means disposition or character

explanation.surface: A figure from Hell is spotted in a picture.
explanation.walkthrough: Distemper is a kind of water-based paint, so 'painting' here is the act of doing it.
explanation.definitionFit: Distemper is a cheap glue-bound paint for walls, and also the technique of painting with it.

clue.text: Flood at lower level on river's banks

parts.note: down means lower or below
R is the standard abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Water rises to a lower level along the river's edges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banks' tells us DOWN lines either side of R, the river.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood is to submerge completely in water, a verb sense shared with this word.

clue.text: Pops' upset stomach

explanation.surface: Dad has an upset tummy.
explanation.walkthrough: Pops and Satchmo were both nicknames of the jazz trumpeter Louis Armstrong; 'Pops'' reads as 'Pops is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are nicknames of the American jazz trumpeter Louis Armstrong.

clue.text: Described in detail former spouse given a beating

parts.note: an ex is a former husband or wife

explanation.surface: Someone gave a detailed account of beating their ex.

clue.text: Maybe pay with dollar to avoid duty

definitions.meaning: read literally, handing over a buck, slang for a dollar
the idiom for shifting responsibility onto someone else

explanation.surface: Settling up in dollars as a way of dodging an obligation.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to shift a responsibility to someone else, and literally a buck is a dollar handed on.

clue.text: Drink's bottomless bottom

parts.note: rump is a word for the backside

explanation.definitionFit: Rum is a spirit distilled from sugar cane, an example of a drink.

explanation.definitionFit: Aesop was the ancient Greek teller of fables, so a writer of fables in the literal sense.

clue.text: Indian part in role of Casablancan pianist?

parts.note: as means in the capacity of

explanation.walkthrough: Sam is the pianist asked to 'play it again' in the 1942 film Casablanca.

clue.text: One to watch succeeded young wizard

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies
Harry Potter is the boy wizard of the novels

clue.text: In race, has to fill position very quickly

taken as written

clue.text: Month's work for jet-propelled swimmer

parts.note: Oct is the abbreviation for October
an opus is a work, especially a musical one

clue.text: Lucky charmers gather round bed

parts.note: to mass is to gather together
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: Fortunate people gather around a bed.

clue.text: Game for trial marriage

parts.note: a test is a trial
a match is a marriage or pairing

explanation.surface: A proposal of a trial marriage, as if it were a game.
explanation.walkthrough: A test match is an international cricket game.
explanation.definitionFit: A test match is an international match in cricket or rugby, so a type of game.

clue.text: New driver with turbo uses shift, getting there eventually

parts.note: L is the learner plate shown by a new driver
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A learner driving a turbo car uses the gear shift and finally arrives.

clue.text: Duo inhabiting ancient world

explanation.surface: A pair living in the ancient world.

clue.text: Shortened composition for sad songs

indicators.note: composing puts parts together in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A truncated piece written for melancholy singing.
explanation.definitionFit: A threnody is a song of lament, especially for the dead.

clue.text: Where Luther would defend eating snakes?

a whimsical reading: a diet made up of worm-like creatures

explanation.surface: Asking where Luther made his stand while dining on serpents.
explanation.definitionFit: The Diet of Worms was the 1521 assembly where Luther refused to recant, and literally a diet of worms is a menu of them.

clue.text: Militarist marine ahead in bet

explanation.surface: A warlike marine is ahead in the betting.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Marines (RM) are Britain's sea-going infantry.
explanation.definitionFit: A warmonger is someone who stirs up or promotes war, much as a militarist does.

clue.text: Conveniently large quantity or zero, literally!

definitions.meaning: a figure ending in zeros, easy to use as an approximation
the figure zero is written as a circle, so it is a numeral that is round

explanation.surface: A big figure that is handy, or nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A round number is a convenient approximate figure, and zero is literally a round digit.

clue.text: Universal air-current between poles chills out

wind is a current of air

clue.text: Money lost to repugnant rival

clue.text: Rogue suffering in vain

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Another business opportunity course

a racecourse in Suffolk, the home of British horse racing

clue.text: Spirit of Prospero's one Lear's mad about

crazed, so the letters are jumbled

clue.text: Old women enable young flyer

parts.note: let means allow or enable

parts.note: taken as written
